title: ExperimentalGatewayAPISupport is set — 1.15 replaces it with --enable-gateway-api

detection.reason: checked in the cert-manager workload's container args only — the gate set through a config file or an environment variable is not scanned

quote: If you had previously enabled this feature flag you will now need to pass the flag `--enable-gateway-api` instead. This is because while the feature is now enabled by default, we still need to gate it behind a flag so cert-manager will not crash if the GatewayAPI CRDs are not installed.
remediation: Replace the `ExperimentalGatewayAPISupport` feature gate with the `--enable-gateway-api` flag. The feature is on by default from 1.15, but the flag is still what stops cert-manager crashing when the Gateway API CRDs are absent.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("cert-manager")) | .spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]? | select(test("GatewayAPI"))'  # any row still naming the feature gate must become --enable-gateway-api

title: ACME preferredChain is matched as documented from 1.15 — the chain served can change

detection.reason: `preferredChain` is not in the issuer projection; ACME issuers are the only ones that carry it

quote: Breaking Change: Fixed unintended certificate chain is used if `preferredChain` is configured.
remediation: Before 1.15 `preferredChain` matched the issuer CN of ANY certificate in an offered chain; from 1.15 it selects the chain as documented. An ACME issuer that sets `preferredChain` can be served a different chain at its next renewal — check that clients which trust only one root still validate it.
verifyCommand: kubectl get issuers,clusterissuers -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select((.spec.acme.preferredChain // "") != "") | "\(.kind)/\(.metadata.namespace // "cluster")/\(.metadata.name) preferredChain=\(.spec.acme.preferredChain)"'  # each row may be served a different chain after the upgrade; NO rows = clean
